headline: IVE open PUBG's new music project with 'Renegade'
sub: An original song made for the game, MV out Dec 2

points.title: What to know
items: IVE are the first artist of the seasonal project
MV teaser is out on PUBG's YouTube
Pop-up and listening party at PUBG Seongsu Dec 2

source: Source: KRAFTON announcement, via Korean media
caption:
IVE are the first artist on PUBG's new seasonal music project, 'THE SQUAD'!

KRAFTON announced that IVE will release 'Renegade,' an original song made for BATTLEGROUNDS, with the full MV dropping Dec 2. Matching collab items arrive on PC on Dec 2, mobile on Dec 7 and console on Dec 10, and IVE will attend a pop-up and listening party at PUBG Seongsu in Seoul.

📌 Source: KRAFTON, via Korean media (MyDaily, Gamemeca)
